verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's pricing page states it prepares responses to Requests for Evidence at no additional fee, so RFE response work is part of the documented service and not just first filings. Its EB-1A guide also discusses RFEs and NOIDs, but only as prevention strategy (front-loading the petition), not as response work. Missing for 10: any description of how RFE responses are handled (process, attorney involvement, timelines), explicit NOID response coverage, and independent or customer corroboration of RFE response outcomes.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get help responding to an RFE or NOID — the provider documents request-for-evidence response work, not just clean first filings
